description: Taxonomy of prompt engineering and context optimization techniques with empirical reliability and cost impact ratings.

techniques.name: XML/Semantic Delimiting
techniques.description: Encapsulates instructions, context, rules, and user data within explicit markup tags.
techniques.recommendation: Adopt across all system prompts and dynamic context injections.

techniques.name: Prefix Cache Invariance
techniques.token_cost_impact: Massive Savings (50-90% discount on cache hits)
techniques.description: Maintains static byte-stable prefixes for instructions and schemas, avoiding dynamic mid-prefix timestamps or volatile variables.
techniques.recommendation: Mandatory standard for agent harness design.

techniques.name: Subagent Down-Tiering
techniques.description: Delegates leaf inspection, search, and validation tasks to fast/flash models while reserving frontier reasoning for synthesis.
techniques.recommendation: Standard harness rule for all exploratory subagents.

techniques.name: Few-Shot Anchoring
techniques.description: Provides 2-3 canonical input/output examples to anchor expected behavior without verbose negative rule lists.
techniques.recommendation: Use for complex transformations, DSLs, or strict schema outputs.

techniques.name: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Scratchpads
techniques.description: Prompts the model to plan or reason through constraints in a dedicated scratchpad before emitting final deliverables.
techniques.recommendation: Use for non-trivial architecture, refactoring, and multi-constraint generation.

techniques.name: Agnostic Web Distillation
techniques.token_cost_impact: Massive Savings (75-90% reduction vs raw HTML)
techniques.description: Processes URLs through readability/markdown extractors to strip DOM boilerplate, navbars, and tracking noise prior to context ingestion.
techniques.recommendation: Mandatory for external documentation and research fetches.

techniques.name: Lossy Syntax Stripping ('Caveman' Prompting)
techniques.description: Deliberately removes natural language articles, grammar, and sentence structure in an attempt to compress token counts.
techniques.recommendation: Strictly forbidden. Impairs reasoning, increases token perplexity, and breaks code syntax.
